Interface LessonGateway

All Known Implementing Classes:
CurrentRepoGateway
public interface LessonGateway
Kanish's session-bound window contract, aligned with Joshua's current four lesson fields. KG01 core CRUD; KG02 authorized visibility; KG03 locks; KG04 experiences. These are local traceability identifiers, not official story numbers. Storage owns authorization and atomic lock enforcement. No view accepts an editable lesson owner or curator-only data.
